name: Canny
description: Canny customer feedback: boards, posts and feature requests, votes, comments, status changes, users and companies with MRR, categories, tags and the public changelog. Canny REST API with the secret API key.
instructions:
## Canny
This connector works with the **Canny API** (`https://canny.io/api`): feedback boards, posts (ideas and feature requests), comments, votes, users and companies, categories, tags, status changes and the changelog. Every Canny call is a `POST` with a JSON body, the reads included: the read tools are marked read-only.

**Setup (1 minute)**
1. In Canny open **Settings > API & Webhooks** (the company settings) and copy the **secret API key**.
2. Paste it into `CANNY_API_KEY`. Canny takes it as the `apiKey` field of every request body; the connector adds it for you.
3. Run `canny_list_boards` to check the key.

**Workflow**
- Explore: `canny_list_boards`, then `canny_get_board`, `canny_list_categories` and `canny_list_tags` for a board.
- Read feedback: `canny_list_posts` (filter by board, status, tags, author, company or search; `sort: score` or `trending` for the most wanted), `canny_get_post` for the full post, `canny_list_comments` and `canny_get_comment` for the discussion, `canny_list_votes` for who voted, `canny_list_status_changes` for the history of status updates.
- People: `canny_list_users` and `canny_get_user` (by Canny id, email or your app's user id), `canny_list_companies` for customer accounts with their MRR. `canny_create_or_update_user` creates a user (or updates the matching one) and returns the Canny id you need as author or voter; with `companies` it also links and creates companies. `canny_update_company` changes name, domain, monthly spend or custom fields.
- Capture feedback: look up or create the user, then `canny_create_post`, or `canny_create_vote` on an existing post when someone asks for something that is already there. `canny_create_comment` adds a comment or reply (`internal: true` for team-only notes).
- Triage: `canny_change_post_status` (open, under review, planned, in progress, complete, closed or a custom status; needs an admin's Canny id as `changer_id`; `should_notify_voters` emails the voters), `canny_update_post` for title, details, ETA, owner or custom fields, `canny_change_post_category`, `canny_add_post_tag` and `canny_remove_post_tag`; `canny_create_category` and `canny_create_tag` to extend a board.
- Changelog: `canny_list_changelog_entries`, `canny_create_changelog_entry` (draft by default, `published: true` or `scheduled_for` to release, `post_ids` to link shipped posts), `canny_update_changelog_entry`, `canny_change_changelog_entry_status` to publish, schedule or unpublish.

**Ids**: all ids are 24-character hex strings. `company_id` filters take the company identifier as returned by `canny_list_companies` (the id from your app when companies are synced). An admin's Canny id (for `changer_id`, `by_id`, `owner_id`) comes from `canny_list_users` (entries with `isAdmin: true`) or `canny_get_user` with the admin's email.

**Reading the answers**: posts carry `score` (vote count), `commentCount`, `status`, `eta` and `url` (the admin link). Times are ISO 8601 UTC. Changelog details are markdown.

**Paging**: two styles. `canny_list_posts`, `canny_list_categories`, `canny_list_tags` and `canny_list_changelog_entries` use `limit` and `skip` and answer `hasMore`. `canny_list_comments`, `canny_list_votes`, `canny_list_users`, `canny_list_companies` and `canny_list_status_changes` use `limit` (up to 100) and `cursor`: pass the returned `cursor` while `hasNextPage` is true.

**Limits and errors**: per key 5 requests per second and 1,000 per hour on Free, 10 and 5,000 on paid plans, 20 and 15,000 on Business; 429 comes with `Retry-After`. Errors arrive as `{"error": "..."}`, e.g. `invalid post id`. There are no delete tools.
prerequisites: A Canny workspace and its secret API key from Settings > API & Webhooks.

CANNY_API_KEY.label: Secret API key
CANNY_API_KEY.help: Canny > Settings > API & Webhooks: the secret API key of your company. It is sent as the apiKey field in the JSON body of every request.
CANNY_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the secret API key, without spaces or quotes.

verifyHints.401: Canny refused the API key. Copy the secret key again from Settings > API & Webhooks.
verifyHints.403: Canny refused the API key. Copy the secret key again from Settings > API & Webhooks.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Canny allows 5 to 20 requests per second depending on the plan. Wait a moment and try again.

tools.name: canny_list_boards
tools.description: All feedback boards of the Canny company with id, name, postCount, isPrivate and url. Start here: most other tools take a board id.

tools.name: canny_get_board
tools.description: One feedback board by id: name, postCount, isPrivate, created date and admin url.

tools.name: canny_list_posts
tools.description: List feedback posts (ideas and feature requests) with title, details, status, score (votes), commentCount, author, board, category, tags, owner, eta and url. Filter by board, author, company, tags, status or a search text; sort by newest, oldest, score, trending, statusChanged or relevance.

author_id.description: Only posts by this Canny user id.

company_id.description: Only posts by users of the company with this identifier (the company id from canny_list_companies).

tag_ids.description: Only posts with at least one of these tag ids.

search.description: Only posts matching this search text.

status.description: Comma-separated statuses, e.g. open,under review,planned,in progress,complete,closed or a custom status.

tools.name: canny_get_post
tools.description: One post with its details, status, score, author, owner, category, tags, custom fields, eta, linked Jira or Linear issues, merge history and url. Pass the post id, or its urlName together with the board id.

url_name.description: The urlName of the post (the last part of its URL); needs board_id.

board_id.description: Board id, only needed with url_name.

tools.name: canny_create_post
tools.description: Create a post (idea or feature request) on a board for a user. Create or look up the author first with canny_create_or_update_user.

author_id.description: Canny user id of the author (from canny_create_or_update_user or canny_get_user).

by_id.description: Canny admin id that creates the post on behalf of the author.

owner_id.description: Admin id responsible for the work.

eta.description: Estimated completion month as MM/YYYY, e.g. 06/2027.

eta_public.description: Show the ETA to all users.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field name; include every field the board requires.

created_at.description: Original creation time in ISO 8601 when importing from another tool.

tools.name: canny_update_post
tools.description: Update a post's title, details, ETA, images, custom fields or owner. Only the fields given change. Changing the owner needs changer_id.

eta_public.description: Show the ETA to all users.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by field name.

image_urls.description: Replaces all images; an empty list removes them.

owner_id.description: Admin id to make the owner.

changer_id.description: Admin id making the change; required with owner_id.

tools.name: canny_change_post_status
tools.description: Change a post's status (open, under review, planned, in progress, complete, closed or a custom status), recorded under an admin, optionally with a comment and an email to the voters.

status.description: New status, e.g. planned, in progress or complete.

changer_id.description: Canny admin id recorded as having changed the status.

should_notify_voters.description: Email the non-admin voters about the change.

comment_value.description: Comment attached to the status change.

tools.name: canny_change_post_category
tools.description: Move a post to another category of its board, or remove its category with the text null.

category_id.description: Category id, or null to remove the category.

tools.name: canny_add_post_tag
tools.description: Add a tag to a post. Tags come from canny_list_tags or canny_create_tag.

tools.name: canny_remove_post_tag
tools.description: Remove a tag from a post. Removing a tag the post does not have changes nothing.

tools.name: canny_list_comments
tools.description: List portal comments, newest first, with value, author, post, parent, internal flag and likes. Filter by post, board, author or company. Paged with a cursor.

author_id.description: Only comments by this user id.

company_id.description: Only comments by users of this company identifier.

cursor.description: The cursor value of the previous answer, to fetch the next page.

tools.name: canny_get_comment
tools.description: One portal comment by id with its value, author, post, images and internal flag.

tools.name: canny_create_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a post, as a reply when parent_id is set. internal comments are visible to the team only.

author_id.description: Canny user id of the author.

internal.description: Team-only comment (the author must be a team member).

should_notify_voters.description: Allow the comment to trigger email notifications (default false).

created_at.description: Original creation time in ISO 8601 when importing.

tools.name: canny_list_votes
tools.description: List votes, newest first, with the voter, post, priority and time. Filter by post, board, user or company. Paged with a cursor.

user_id.description: Only votes by this Canny user id.

company_id.description: Only votes by users of this company identifier.

cursor.description: The cursor value of the previous answer, to fetch the next page.

tools.name: canny_create_vote
tools.description: Record a vote by a user on a post, optionally with a priority, for example when a customer asks for a feature in a call or ticket.

voter_id.description: Canny user id of the voter.

by_id.description: Canny admin id casting the vote on the voter's behalf.

vote_priority.description: 0 nice to have, 10 important, 20 must have.

created_at.description: Original vote time in ISO 8601 when importing.

tools.name: canny_list_users
tools.description: List the end users of the workspace with id, name, email, userID (the id in your app), companies and admin flag. Paged with a cursor.

cursor.description: The cursor value of the previous answer, to fetch the next page.

tools.name: canny_get_user
tools.description: Find one user by exactly one of: Canny id, email, or the user id in your application.

user_id.description: The user's id in your application (SSO or API created users).

tools.name: canny_create_or_update_user
tools.description: Create a user, or update the one matching email, user_id or id, and return its Canny id for use as author or voter. Can also link the user to companies, which creates the companies.

name.description: User name, up to 50 characters, without : or /.

user_id.description: The user's id in your application.

id.description: Canny user id, to update an existing user.

alias.description: Alias shown instead of the name.

custom_fields.description: Custom user fields; names under 30 characters, text values under 200.

created.description: When the user was created in your system, ISO 8601.

tools.name: canny_list_companies
tools.description: List companies (customer accounts) with id, name, domain, monthlySpend, memberCount and custom fields, ordered by creation. Search by name or filter by segment. Paged with a cursor except when searching.

search.description: Text to search in company names.

segment.description: URL name of a segment to filter by.

cursor.description: The cursor value of the previous answer, to fetch the next page.

tools.name: canny_update_company
tools.description: Update a company's name, domain, monthly spend (MRR in dollars), creation date or custom fields. Synced CRMs may overwrite these values.

created.description: When the company was created in your system, ISO 8601.

tools.name: canny_list_categories
tools.description: List post categories (and subcategories with parentID), newest first, with name, postCount and board. Filter by board.

tools.name: canny_create_category
tools.description: Create a category, or a subcategory with parent_id, on a board.

parent_id.description: Parent category id for a subcategory.

subscribe_admins.description: Subscribe all admins to new posts in this category.

tools.name: canny_list_tags
tools.description: List tags, newest first, with id, name, postCount and board. Filter by board.

tools.name: canny_create_tag
tools.description: Create a tag on a board, or return the existing tag with that name.

tools.name: canny_list_status_changes
tools.description: History of post status changes, newest first: post, old and new status, changer and the attached comment. Filter by board. Paged with a cursor.

board_id.description: Only status changes on this board.

cursor.description: The cursor value of the previous answer, to fetch the next page.

tools.name: canny_list_changelog_entries
tools.description: List changelog entries, drafts and scheduled ones included, with title, markdown details, status, types, labels, linked posts, publishedAt and url.

label_ids.description: Only entries with at least one of these label ids.

sort.description: Order: created, lastSaved, publishedAt (most recent first) or nonPublishedFirst (default).

tools.name: canny_create_changelog_entry
tools.description: Write a changelog entry as a draft (default), publish it now or schedule it, and link the posts it ships. notify emails users once it is published.

published_on.description: Published date in the past, ISO 8601, with published true.

scheduled_for.description: Future publish time in ISO 8601; published must be false.

notify.description: Email users when it is published (default false).

post_ids.description: Post ids shipped by this entry.

tools.name: canny_update_changelog_entry
tools.description: Change the title, details, types, labels, linked posts or notify flag of a changelog entry. Lists given replace the old ones. Publishing state is not changed here.

types.description: Replaces the types: new, improved, fixed.

notify.description: Email users when it is published.

tools.name: canny_change_changelog_entry_status
tools.description: Publish a changelog entry now, schedule it for a future time, or set it back to draft (unpublish or unschedule). Publishing emails users when the entry has notify on.

published_on.description: Published date in the past, ISO 8601, with status published.

scheduled_for.description: Future publish time in ISO 8601; required with status scheduled.
